html:
Mengistu Haile Mariam is the army officer who led the Derg, the military council that overthrew Emperor Haile Selassie in 1974, and ruled Ethiopia until 1991.

The Derg nationalised all rural land in 1975, ending the old landlord system, and made Ethiopia a Marxist state allied to the Soviet Union. Mengistu took full control in 1977 and launched the Red Terror against rival leftists, in which many thousands were killed.

His rule saw the Ogaden War, the famine of 1983 to 1985, forced resettlement and wars with rebels in Eritrea and Tigray. As rebel armies closed in, in May 1991 he fled to Zimbabwe, where he still lives. An Ethiopian court sentenced him to death in absence for genocide.
sum: Mengistu Haile Mariam is the army officer who led the Derg, the military council that overthrew Emperor Haile Selassie in 1974, and ruled Ethiopia until 1991.
